en.title: Interval Usage with Non-Overlapping Overrides
en.description:
Intervals with usage=1 are unioned; usage=0 does not clear anything; non-overlapping override intervals overwrite the usage result.

This site's standard input/output format and supplementary bounds follow this problem's description.
en.input: The input is D and U, followed by U lines l r v; then O, followed by O lines l r v. 1≤D≤2×10^5, U,O≤2×10^5; intervals are closed and lie within [1,D], v∈{0,1}; override intervals are pairwise non-overlapping.
en.output: Output a 0/1 string of length D.
en.explanation: For Usage, use a difference array to check whether the coverage count is greater than 0; each override directly overwrites its closed interval. A day-by-day simulation serves as an independent oracle. Time O(D+U+total covered override length), space O(D).
